_comment: Every picture in doc/screenshots, and exactly how it was taken.
The point of writing them down is that the interface changes. A toolbar
gains a button, a panel is renamed, a mode learns a new gesture, and
every picture in the handbook is quietly a picture of last month's
program. Replaying this file is one command:
shows     what the picture is of, for somebody deciding whether it
still says that after a change
used-in   where the handbook or the README puts it
size      window size, when it is not the default
grab      window (the default), active or both
dialogs   leave when a modal dialog is the subject, otherwise reject
The first four are the ones the README shows. Their names are part of
the README and must not change.

shots.name: read-and-fill-in
shots.shows: Reading, with the form on page 12 part filled in: the pale wash over what can be answered, the red rule round the two required fields, the grey dashes round what is locked

shots.name: edit-the-page
shots.shows: Editing the page, with every run of text that can be written into outlined faintly before anything is clicked

shots.name: edit-the-form
shots.shows: Laying a form out: the field toolbar with every kind at once, and the fields drawn by the program rather than by the page

shots.name: arrange-the-pages
shots.shows: Every page of the document as one grid, in the order it will be saved in

shots.name: the-three-sidebars
shots.shows: All three side panels open at once beside the photograph on page 6: pages, contents and properties

shots.name: contents-sidebar
shots.shows: The table of contents as a tree, each entry with the page it points at, following the reader down the document

shots.name: properties-a-line-of-text
shots.shows: The properties sidebar with the caret in a line: the face the page sets it in, the typeface, size, bold, italic and colour it is to be set in, and whether its box grows

shots.name: an-object-with-handles
shots.shows: Something the page draws, chosen: eight handles round it, a ninth on a stalk to turn it by, and the properties sidebar saying where it comes in the painting order and that this cannot be changed

shots.name: comments-and-the-pens
shots.shows: The four kinds of comment on page 14, with the pens on the page toolbar and a comment picked so that the properties sidebar names it

shots.name: properties-a-form-field
shots.shows: The properties sidebar with a field chosen while the form is being designed: its place and size, its name and label, its rules and how it looks, all of it editable. Clicked rather than picked by name, because clicking is what reaches the layer that lays the form out

shots.name: properties-filling-a-field-in
shots.shows: The properties sidebar with a field chosen while the form is being filled in: the same field, shown rather than changed, because its name and rules are the form author's and the one thing that is yours is given on the page

shots.name: fill-in-the-form-as-a-list
shots.shows: The page on one side and every field of the form as a list on the other, with the locked fields shown and refused rather than left out

shots.name: the-file-menu
shots.shows: The File menu, including the Export as submenu's parent entry

shots.name: the-view-menu
shots.shows: The View menu: the four modes at the top, then getting about, what a drag does, the five sizes and the three side panels

shots.name: the-pages-menu
shots.shows: The Pages menu: turning and throwing away, trimming, numbering and sheets, signing, watermarking and redacting, scans and compression, correcting the words, and the Mark Up submenu

shots.name: the-tools-menu
shots.shows: The Tools menu: the windows that look into a document, and the one entry in it that is not a window

shots.name: trim-the-edges
shots.shows: Trimming: the page where the grid was and the four measurements in a panel at the edge of the window

shots.name: redact
shots.shows: Redaction: the marking tools, the list of marked areas, the words that will be destroyed, and the box saying what this does and does not do

shots.name: sign
shots.shows: Signing: the stored signatures on one side and the page to put one on beside them

shots.name: watermark
shots.shows: A watermark previewed on the page itself, drawn the way it will be written

shots.name: page-numbers
shots.shows: Page numbers and Bates stamping, with the stamp shown where it will land and a line saying what this page will say

shots.name: make-smaller
shots.shows: The four compression levels, what each one does to the pictures, and the button that answers how much it would save before anything is committed to

shots.name: recognise-text
shots.shows: Text recognition: the languages installed on this machine, the detail to read at, skipping pages that already have text, straightening, and the two settings for a bad original

shots.name: add-blank-pages
shots.shows: Adding blank pages: how many, and a size matched to the page the new ones will sit beside rather than to page one

shots.name: split
shots.shows: The four ways of splitting a document, with the file names it is about to write and how many pages each will get listed before anything is written

shots.name: arrange-on-sheets
shots.shows: Several pages on one sheet, with a preview of the arrangement beside the settings

shots.name: export-as-images
shots.shows: Writing one picture per page: the format, the detail and the quality, which goes quiet for a lossless format

shots.name: document-properties
shots.shows: The title, author, subject and keywords, what the document was created with, what wrote it, and the two dates

shots.name: clean-up-document
shots.shows: What the document actually carries, named rather than called metadata, and the two things that can be removed

shots.name: password
shots.shows: Setting the password that opens the document, the two permissions beside it, and what the dialog says they are worth

shots.name: check-the-document
shots.shows: The preflight check: a profile, what it found grouped so that anything which would get the file rejected is at the top, and the box headed what was not checked

shots.name: fonts
shots.shows: Every font the document uses, whether it travels with the file, whether only part of it is there, and whether its text can be copied out

shots.name: colour
shots.shows: What the document does with colour: its spaces, its spot inks, whether it carries a profile, and how thin its thinnest stroke is

shots.name: pictures
shots.shows: Every picture in the document with its effective resolution on the page rather than its pixel count

shots.name: page-setup
shots.shows: The five boxes a page can carry, per page and in millimetres, saying absent where a page defines none

shots.name: the-page-as-a-list
shots.shows: What a page draws, as a list, topmost first, with the boxes on the page and the rows beside it being the same list twice

shots.name: set-text-as-pages
shots.shows: Making a document out of typed or pasted text, with the preview written by the same engine that writes the finished document

shots.name: form-behaviour-and-answers
shots.shows: The parts of a form that are not a gesture on a page: its fields, the tab order, behaviour, the answers, and placing a field by its four numbers
